description: This Java class, `IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer`, helps enforce size restrictions on JSON data associated with 'things' in an indexing system. It provides mechanisms to check and truncate JSON string values to conform to maximum index content length restrictions, considering overheads for thing IDs and authorization subjects.

classes.name: IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer
classes.description: A utility class designed to enforce size restrictions on JSON data entries for indexing, ensuring that JSON keys and string values do not exceed predefined length limits.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of `IndexLengthRestrictionEnforcer` with given thing ID after validation.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Checks a JSON pointer and its associated value against size restrictions. If the value is a string and exceeds size constraints when combined with its key overhead, it is truncated. If it's a composite object or array, it throws an exception or returns the value as is.

methods.name: fixViolation
methods.description: Truncates a JSON string value to fit within size limits by encoding it into UTF-8 and cutting off excess bytes if necessary.
